messages:
elaine: heads up: noticed a cluster of tenants where console rollout % for 'new-routing-policy' shows 0% but router logs show ~5% traffic going to canary. Seems correlated with Go client upgrades (v0.9.0).

ryan: any repro or headers? could be header format change. :eyes:

elaine: minimal repro we used internally:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SSS' \\ 
  -H 'X-Route: experimental' \\ 
  -H 'X-Go-SDK-Head: egc:ZXhwZXJpbWVudA==' \\ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

hao: uh the go sdk added a header rewriting feature that encodes route hints into X-Go-SDK-Head to avoid collisions. gateway used to ignore it, but the new router fast-path started decoding any header prefixed with 'egc:' and treating it as authoritative. that was not intended.

viv: also we're seeing telemetry sampling mismatches in the console: the rollout tile aggregates traces at sample rate 1% but go sdk now emits a telemetry-sample=0 by default for dev builds, which skewed the observed percent in the console and made the dashboard show 0% for many tenants.

elaine: painful combo: router honoring encoded header -> traffic split, but console samplers drop those spans so rollout dashboard misses them.

ryan: mitigation plan proposal:
1) hotfix in router: ignore X-Go-SDK-Head decoding unless tenant feature-flag enabled. add metric routing.decoded_go_sdk_header_count.
2) quick patch to Go SDK v0.9.1: stop emitting encoded route header by default; make it opt-in with env GO_SDK_ROUTE_ENCODE=1.
3) console: add fallback aggregation that counts routing decisions from router logs (not just sampled traces) to compute rollout %, and mark data source in tile.

hao: I'll PR router change and add unit tests. will canary to eu-west first.

viv: I'll add a console query and tile mock: columns tenant | observed_router_canary_pct | trace_sampled_pct | data_source. add alert if router_pct > trace_pct by >1% for paid tenants.

elaine: timeline: router canary within 1 hour; go sdk patch and release within 3 hours; console tile + alert within the next 24h. also we should add an ops-runbook entry explaining how encoded headers interact with rolling policies.

ryan: agree. add audit log when router decodes X-Go-SDK-Head so we can see who relied on it. we should also search for other SDKs doing similar header tricks.

ops-bot: Deploy started: router-ignore-gosdk-head -> canary (4 instances) by hao at 6195001280

elaine: thanks all. once go patch is out let's coordinate a short note to support and include a small blurb in the release notes about telemetry sampling and rollout visibility. tagging @ryan @hao @viv
